sections.title: Medical Image Analysis
sections.description: This 0.5 CU course provides a comprehensive introduction to medical image analysis. Students will learn the basics of Computer Vision with an emphasis on the special challenges of automated medical image analysis for clinical healthcare and medical research. Students will be required to visually assess the images and work with key Machine Learning technology to interpret data on the actual medical image scans. The course is appropriate for students without prior medical or imaging training.
